label: Import Process (Sync Gateway)
type: the mechanism that picks up non-Sync-Gateway document mutations (writes made directly to Couchbase Server, e.g. via SDK/SQL++) and runs them through the sync function to compute read security and channel routing, enabling mobile convergence. Gated by sgw:import-docs-setting. Distinct from that setting: the setting is the boolean that enables it, this concept is the mechanism itself.
evidence: The import process is a key part of mobile convergence.
note: Minted on its own dedicated page (import-processing.json) and reused, near-verbatim, on sync-with-couchbase-server.json - the same content appearing on two pages under two different anchors, flagged by the latter record as an extraction-layer duplication observation. Processes the document with an admin user context in the sync function (triggersPermissionModeChange), meaning requireAccess/requireUser/requireRole calls become no-ops during import - the sync function's write-time authorization gate does not apply to server-side writes.
